title: GSA acquisition and NIST ARIA accounts preserve the boundary before operation
summary: Two existing Atlas accounts gain twelve sections and seven dated events. Six newly inspected primary records distinguish procurement guidance and developing identity testing from completed migration, and evaluation methods from continuous assurance.
evidence_note: Four HTML bodies and two PDF text records were inspected November 22. PDF page images were not inspected. Month-level dates, schedules, publication approval and operational decisions remain separate. GSA still contributes zero eligible projects; ARIA remains one existing pilot. No governed stage, operating outcome or Phase 60 gate is added.
publication_effect: Local source integration only; production rendering, release and launch remain unverified.
